title.zh: 【印度央行与金融情报机构审查境外加密卡，多名用户反映卡片在印度无法使用】
title.en: 【印度央行与金融情报机构审查境外加密卡，多名用户反映卡片在印度无法使用】

current_state.zh: India's central bank and financial intelligence unit are reviewing foreign-issued crypto cards that let residents convert crypto into rupees for domestic spending and cash withdrawals, as multiple users report their cards stopped working in India from October 29 and some provider sites became inaccessible.
current_state.en: India's central bank and financial intelligence unit are reviewing foreign-issued crypto cards that let residents convert crypto into rupees for domestic spending and cash withdrawals, as multiple users report their cards stopped working in India from October 29 and some provider sites became inaccessible.
